title: MSIT 2026 budget for AI transformation
summary: AI share of the Ministry of Science and ICT's 2026 budget, which was finalised at KRW 23.7417 trillion after the National Assembly approved it on 2 December 2025. MSIT states that KRW 5.1 trillion of this goes to AI transformation: advancing the 'AI Highway' compute infrastructure, developing AI technologies and talent, promoting AI adoption and building an AI-ready society. The ministry's release does not break the AI figure down by programme in its text.
purpose: Fund MSIT's AI transformation programmes in 2026, including AI compute infrastructure, AI technology and talent, and AI adoption.

sources.title: MSIT's 2026 Budget Finalized at KRW 23.7 Trillion
